title: Single-Point Higher-Order Szegő Sum Rules in OPUC: Necessity for $m=1,2,3$
summary: We give a direct algebraic proof of the necessity direction in the single-point higher-order Szegő sum rules on the unit circle for $m=1,2,3$. More precisely, for $H_m(e^{iθ})=(1-\cosθ)^m$, we show that $\int_0^{2π}H_m(e^{iθ})\log w(θ)\frac{dθ}{2π}>-\infty$ implies $(S-1)^mα\in\ell^2,\qquad α\in\ell^{2m+2}.$ The proof is carried out within Yan's algebraic model for higher-order sum rules.
